minutes_briefs.title: Burnaby's 2026 tax exemption bylaw changes who can skip property taxes
minutes_briefs.summary: Burnaby has adopted Bylaw 14854, the Taxation Exemption Bylaw 2026. This bylaw sets out which properties in the city can be exempted (let off) from paying property tax for the 2026 tax year. It covers things like exemptions for certain non-profit, charitable, or other qualifying properties. If your property is not listed as exempt, you pay the full property tax bill as usual.
minutes_briefs.action_required: Check with Burnaby's tax office whether your property qualifies for a 2026 exemption, and budget to pay full property tax if it does not.
